description: Use to send one stored submission to its webhook again, now: after the receiving endpoint was down or fixed, or to backfill a submission that arrived before the webhook was set. Find candidates with list_submissions webhook=failed. Returns the delivery; status is success, or pending with last_error when the attempt failed and is back on the retry schedule. The delivery id (X-Furrow-Delivery) and submission id do not change, so the receiver can dedupe. Refused for spam and when the form resolves no webhook. Do not use this to check that a webhook URL works — call test_webhook. Do not loop it over submissions that are still pending; those retry on their own for about 8.5 hours.

submission_id.description: Submission id from list_submissions or a webhook payload.
